Ce que disent ceux qui travaillent avec: What the people who work with us say.
Real stores, in their own words. We publish reviews as given to us, with the authors' consent.
Les avis de boutiques qui utilisent Lyst: Reviews from stores that use Lystes AI every day.
Prévisualisation : les avis affichés son: Preview: the reviews shown are layout examples.
Programme premières boutiques : onboardi: First-stores program: live onboarding with the founder, priority requests on the roadmap, price locked for life, and your case study documented with you, backed by figures.
La démo est ouverte, sans carte bancaire: The demo is open, no credit card needed. Ask your customers' toughest question.
J'étais sceptique, je le dis franchement: I was skeptical, I'll say it plainly. A robot talking to my customers, not for me. Then I reread the first week's conversations: 43 questions handled, answers I would have given myself, sometimes better phrased. I only corrected the brief twice.
Le diagnostic de peau sur la fiche produ: My customers love the skin diagnosis on the product page. It's become the first thing I show in the shop.
Installé un dimanche soir, en 12 minutes: Installed on a Sunday evening, in 12 minutes, between two order preparations. I called no one, coded nothing. Monday morning, it was already answering size questions.
Ce qui m'a convaincue, c'est qu'il conna: What convinced me is that it knows EVERY product. A customer was hesitating between two serums, it compared both formulas and steered her to the cheaper one, because it was the right one for her. A rushed salesperson couldn't have done better.
L'essayage virtuel des montures, honnête: The virtual frame try-on, honestly, we didn't think it would work this well. Our product returns have dropped.
On aurait pu bricoler un truc nous-mêmes: We could have hacked something together ourselves with ChatGPT, and actually tried. Two wasted weekends. Here, everything is connected to the catalog, reviews, stock, and above all someone replies when I write. For the price of a restaurant a month, the math is quick.
Enfin un outil pensé pour les petites bo: Finally a tool designed for small stores, not just the big ones. And in French.
Je relis les conversations chaque soir,: I reread the conversations every evening, it's my little ritual. At first to check, now to learn: I discover the real questions my customers ask, the ones they never dared to ask me by email.
Il ne sait pas tout, et c'est ce qui me: It doesn't know everything, and that's what reassures me. When a customer has a delivery dispute, it doesn't improvise as customer service: it hands it off to me. Everyone has their job.
